slides.text:
Another copyright claim
on your episode?

Most “royalty-free” music
is licensed to you

But somebody else still owns it

Which is why the claim lands
months after you publish

Cast generates the music instead

Mubert owns the samples outright

slides.heading: Music that can’t be claimed
slides.body: Cast writes the intro, outro and bed for your episode — generative, editable, and cleared for commercial use
